Ingredients: Chicken breast, rice, broccoli, soy sauce
Method: Cook the rice. Cook the chicken in a pan until fully cooked. Steam the broccoli. Add the chicken and broccoli to the rice. Add soy sauce and serve.

Ingredients: Beef mince, rice, beans, tortilla, cheese, salsa
Method: Cook the beef mince in a pan. Cook the rice and beans. Place the beef, rice and beans onto the tortilla. Add cheese and salsa. Fold the tortilla and serve.

Ingredients: Chicken breast, lettuce, tomato, cucumber, carrot, light dressing
Method: Cook the chicken until fully cooked. Chop the lettuce, tomato, cucumber and carrot. Add everything to a bowl. Add the dressing and mix together.

Ingredients: Oats, milk, protein powder, banana, berries
Method: Add oats and milk to a bowl. Cook until the oats are soft. Mix in the protein powder. Slice the banana and add it with the berries.

Ingredients: Turkey breast, tortilla, lettuce, tomato, cheese, light mayonnaise
Method: Place the turkey, lettuce and tomato onto the tortilla. Add cheese and mayonnaise. Fold the tortilla and serve.

Ingredients: Eggs, wholegrain bread, milk, butter, pepper
Method: Crack the eggs into a bowl and add a small amount of milk. Whisk the eggs. Cook them in a pan with butter until scrambled. Toast the bread and serve together.

Ingredients: Salmon fillet, sweet potato, broccoli, olive oil, lemon
Method: Cut the sweet potato into pieces and bake until soft. Cook the salmon in a pan or oven until fully cooked. Steam the broccoli. Serve with lemon and a small amount of olive oil.

Ingredients: Chicken breast, broccoli, capsicum, carrot, zucchini, olive oil
Method: Cut the chicken and vegetables into pieces. Cook the chicken in a pan until fully cooked. Add the vegetables and cook until soft. Add a small amount of olive oil and serve.

Ingredients: Tuna, pasta, tomato sauce, spinach, parmesan cheese
Method: Cook the pasta. Drain the tuna. Heat the tomato sauce in a pan and add the tuna and spinach. Mix with the pasta. Add parmesan cheese and serve.

Ingredients: Oats, eggs, banana, protein powder, milk, berries
Method: Blend the oats, eggs, banana, protein powder and milk. Pour the mixture into a heated pan. Cook both sides until golden. Add berries and serve.

Ingredients: Chicken breast, tortillas, capsicum, onion, lettuce, salsa
Method: Slice the chicken, capsicum and onion. Cook the chicken in a pan until fully cooked. Add the capsicum and onion. Place the mixture into tortillas. Add lettuce and salsa.

Ingredients: Eggs, spinach, capsicum, tomato, onion, cheese
Method: Whisk the eggs. Cook the onion and capsicum in a pan. Add the eggs and spinach. Add tomato and cheese. Fold the omelette and cook until the egg is fully set.

Ingredients: Beef steak, potatoes, green beans, olive oil, butter
Method: Cut the potatoes and bake until golden. Cook the steak in a pan to your preferred level of doneness. Steam the green beans. Serve together with a small amount of butter.

Ingredients: Tuna, avocado, lettuce, cucumber, tomato, lemon juice
Method: Drain the tuna. Chop the avocado, lettuce, cucumber and tomato. Add everything to a bowl. Add lemon juice and mix together.

Ingredients: Mixed berries, banana, milk, protein powder, Greek yoghurt
Method: Add the berries, banana, milk, protein powder and Greek yoghurt to a blender. Blend until smooth. Pour into a glass and serve.
